components.label: FastAPI API
components.sublabel: 9 endpoints · no auth · 512 KB body cap

cards.title: Deterministic core is the source of truth
items: measurement → geometry → validation → learning; no HTTP, DB or LLM import in any domain module
Six checks in a fixed order, all always run — a wrong-scale sheet reports every downstream cause, not the first
Exact Decimal throughout; wire values are strings so 4.6 mm never becomes 4.5999999999999996
explain reads the stored result, never live geometry, so prose always matches the verdict on screen

cards.title: Trust boundaries
items: No authentication anywhere — zero authn, authz, tenant scoping or admin path by explicit decision
Proxy is the one enforced provenance gate: drops cookie/origin/referer, target host comes only from config, so it is not an open forwarder
Tutor output is untrusted text; any number absent from the validator payload discards the whole explanation
exercise_attempts has no owner column, so every stored student_geometry is readable by any reachable client
Posture rests entirely on the loopback bind address (HOST=127.0.0.1), not on any code control

cards.title: Frontend runtime
items: All state is local useState in one component — no store, no query library, no providers, no middleware
Two base URLs on purpose: server components resolve an internal host, the bundle carries /api
With NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=/api the CORS boundary disappears and the API is never exposed publicly
No CDN, analytics or runtime third-party fetch; fonts are self-hosted at build time

cards.title: External dependencies
items: PostgreSQL 14+ via SQLAlchemy and psycopg3; URL read from settings so alembic.ini holds no credentials
One outbound integration only: an OpenAI-compatible chat/completions API (Groq in development)
Both are optional — blank TUTOR_BASE_URL disables the tutor and deterministic prose is served instead
No queue, worker, cache, webhook, object storage or third-party SDK of any kind

cards.title: Worth flagging
items: limit and offset are unvalidated — /exercises?limit=-1 returns 500, and a huge limit reads unbounded
assert_no_secrets is never invoked from a route or a test, despite its docstring claiming it runs
httpx is declared only under [dev] yet is a runtime import; a production install silently degrades every explanation
The size limiter buffers the full body before checking length, so it does not actually bound memory
